Name: JP's Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights (Taiwanese translation)
Author: JIAWANSHEN
Description:
[size=3][color=#ea9999]⚠ Language Notice[/color]
This is a Traditional Chinese (Taiwan / zh-TW) translation reminder.
Due to Nexus Mods language limitations, Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) is not available as a selectable language.
For technical reasons, this translation is therefore listed under English.
All in-game text provided by this mod is in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

[color=#ea9999]⚠ 關於此模組（正體中文）[/color]
此模組為 **[/size] JP's Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights[size=3]** 的  
**正體中文（台灣／Traditional Chinese）翻譯模組**。
由於 Nexus Mods 不支援將「正體中文（Traditional Chinese）」設為語言分類，  
因此本翻譯模組暫時歸類於 **English**。

[color=#999999]**************************************************************************************************[/color]

這是[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/juanpa98ar?gameId=1303] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57354076]juanpa98ar[/url]﻿製作的夜間生物[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38489]JP's Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights[/url]的繁體中文（台灣）翻譯檔,
此頁面[color=#f4cccc]僅提供翻譯檔案[/color], 原始模組請至 Original File 下載。


[i][i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/juanpa98ar?gameId=1303] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57354076]juanpa98ar[/url]﻿ :[/i][/i]『[i]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/i] 』

[/i]所以此模組一定要安裝GMCM哦!
因為原模組頁面並沒有說明必要安裝的輔助mod, 所以我也不清楚主要mod需求...


[color=#cc0000]注意[/color]：
﻿>此檔案需要原始模組, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57354076]juanpa98ar[/url] 的「[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38489]JP's Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights[/url]﻿」。
﻿﻿>原始檔案會有多種名稱。
﻿>﻿﻿可以的話, 請下載並安裝中文字型較為齊全的mod, 如果用原本簡體字的遊戲運行, 會出現大量缺字![/size]


[size=2]
[color=#6aa84f]如何安裝[/color]：
>﻿下載[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38489]JP's Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights[/url]﻿[/size][size=2]﻿和本檔案JP's Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights (Taiwanese translation)。
>﻿先﻿把原始模組資料夾 DebrisIsInTheAir 放在MODs資料夾內之後,
>﻿﻿再把 Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights(Taiwanese) 裡面的 DebrisIsInTheAir 移到MODs資料夾裡,
﻿>﻿﻿i18n資料夾裡面有zh.json就行啦。
﻿﻿>更新的話, 把舊的檔案刪除之後, 重複上面的步驟就可以了。


[color=#e69138]Vortex安裝說明[/color]：
﻿﻿>此檔案可使用Vortex自動安裝, 用〔Mod manager download〕下載兩個檔案,
﻿>在Vortex介面點入左側 Mods , 會有 Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights 和 Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights(Taiwanese) ,
﻿>先安裝 Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights, 安裝之後檔案會變成 (JP98) Debris Is In the Air - The Night Lights ,
﻿>之後安裝本檔案 Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights(Taiwanese) , 
﻿>(嫌麻煩就同時選取兩個檔案安裝也沒事)
﻿>這樣就完成了! 
﻿>更新的話, 因為1.0.5檔名有變動, 先把舊的刪除檔案1.0.4, 重新上面步驟安裝就可以了。
﻿

[color=#f1c232]補充[/color]：
﻿>此模組的開發者還有建一個自然生物, 我是覺得還算自然~ 有興趣的可以去看看! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41179]JP's Debris is in the Air - Critters[/url]﻿
﻿>Default和Custom無法顯示, 是因為開發者並沒有設定到i18n裡面, 我會詢問看看有無新增的可能性, 或是自己學起來是什麼意思也可以。
﻿>Baubles這詞我不知道要翻成什麼, 它是圓球類的小吊飾, 常見於聖誕樹裝飾上、節慶布置上, 圓色的光我就想到光暈了。[/size]
 ﻿>我把GMCM會顯示中文檔名的檔案放到 "Debris is in the Air - The Night Lights(personal)" 裡面了, 因為是自用, 所以有興趣的人在下載。
﻿

[size=5]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.[/size]
[size=5]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.[/size]
[size=5]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
